messages:
nina: FYI linkcheck flagged two broken fragments after the slugifier update: /migration#runtime-config and /sdk/python#embed-sample

ravi: which PR changed slug behavior?

nina: PR 2902 — slugify normalization now produces a nonbreaking hyphen in some IDs so ASCII-fragment links 404.

joel: quick fixes: add explicit MDX ids, update examples with path-only links, or insert aliases in built HTML.

ravi: i prefer updating examples to use stable IDs where possible, but MDX explicit ids are easiest for a fast patch.

nina: opened PR 2910 with `{#runtime-config}` and `{#embed-sample}` added plus linkcheck fixtures. preview build still shows generated ids with U+2011 so CI fails.

ci-bot: Linkcheck: FAIL -> fragment 'runtime-config' not found in /migration/index.html

joel: pipeline ordering is the culprit. short-term workaround: run a tiny post-build script on previews that injects ASCII alias anchors next to headings.

ravi: please add a 2-week whitelist for the two fragments and file an infra ticket to reorder processors.

nina: done — INFRA-1310 filed. injector added to preview pipeline on my fork; preview linkcheck passed. merging to get docs green. follow-ups: audit top-linked pages for literal fragment URLs and plan to remove injector after infra fix.

joel: thanks — i'll take the audit and flag any code-block literals. :thumbsup:
